title_en: Somadeva. Kathāsaritsāgara (Ocean of the Streams of Stories)
sanskrit_source: GRETIL sa_somadeva-kathAsaritsAgara (after Durgāprasād & K. P. Parab, Nirṇaya-sāgara ed.), IAST plain text
alignment_method: Lingtrain Alignment Studio v8.4-labse — LaBSE sentence alignment, hand-corrected; sentence-level (not śloka-keyed). Passage key = lambaka.taraṅga.sentence-ordinal.
coverage: lambakas 1–10 of 18 (~66 taraṅgas, 9998 aligned sentence pairs); books 11–18 not yet aligned
provenance: Sanskrit from GRETIL (sa_somadeva-kathAsaritsAgara); Russian from the multi-volume Serebryakov et al. Nauka translation. Aligned sentence-by-sentence in Lingtrain Studio (upstream Marc-Winner/somadeva); converted to canonical JSONL via web/corpus_builder/somadeva_lingtrain_to_canonical.py (H907, Opus 4.8 claude-opus-4-8). Devanagari transliterated to IAST/SLP1 via indic_transliteration.
rights: in-copyright modern Russian academic translation (И. Д. Серебряков et al., 20th c., Nauka) — corpus rights stay grey per project ruling; no redistribution, export bulk gitignored. Same status as the Grintser Rāmāyaṇa already in the corpus.
bibliography_status: provisional — the Russian spans several Serebryakov Nauka volumes (Повесть о царе Удаяне 1967 = kk. 1–5; Дальнейшие похождения царевича Нараваханадатты 1976; etc.); verify the exact volume/translator/year per lambaka against the physical editions before НКРЯ submission.
